subject: Startups
title: Figma vs. Adobe: Collaboration Wins
description: A fast breakdown of Figma vs. Adobe: Collaboration Wins for builders.

hook.text: Adobe dominated design for 30 years. Then Figma let designers collaborate in real time, and everything changed.

buildup.text: Figma ran in the browser. No downloads, no licenses. Send a link and anyone can view or edit the design.

discovery.text: Every shared Figma link turned a viewer into a potential user. PMs, developers, and marketers all started using it.

twist.text: Adobe tried to buy Figma for $20 billion. Regulators blocked the deal. Figma had become that threatening.

climax.text: Figma proved that collaboration itself is a growth engine. Multiplayer tools spread faster than single-player ones.

quiz.question: How much did Adobe offer to acquire Figma?
